entries.3d595b0d5f31d1a4: The company is a general construction company in which the construction business accounts for about 98% of consolidated net sales. Net sales to external customers in Japan exceed 90% of consolidated net sales, so domestic operations are central. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the main customer was Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd., and completed construction revenue from it was ¥15,986 million. In the previous consolidated fiscal year, the main customers were Kyocera Corporation ¥19,076 million, Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. ¥13,273 million and CRE, Inc. ¥12,987 million. Izumi Kabushiki Kaisha is a major shareholder holding 35.46% of voting rights as of March 31, 2026. While private-sector capital investment remains firm in the construction market, the company faces a harsh business environment, with continued surges in energy and material prices and rising labor costs.

entries.b01ddcb69592d420: Drawing on its history since its founding in 1705 and the technical expertise accumulated as a family trade of master carpenters for shrines and temples, the company is working to strengthen technical proposal capabilities and design and cost estimation, actively adopt industrialized and labor-saving construction methods, and carry out technology development and commercialization through joint development with industry, academia and government and collaboration with companies in other industries.
entries.b83f1306a03c37d8: The company motto consists of 'Credit First,' 'Sound Management,' 'Positive Spirit' and 'Harmony and Cooperation,' and its management philosophy includes 'to develop eternally as a company recognized and needed by society.' The management strategy consists of four elements: expanding orders through thorough analysis of domestic and overseas markets; establishing a production system that responds to customer satisfaction and enhances profitability; building an internal control system; and practicing management that fulfills corporate social responsibility.
